summary: postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote code from bare-IP HTTP endpoint
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script downloads JavaScript from http://185.14.92.233:7777/p.js over plain HTTP to a bare IP, writes it to the OS temp directory, and executes it via a generated VBScript launcher (_r.vbs) that invokes WScript.Shell.Run with the window-hidden flag and no-wait, spawning wscript.exe detached with stdio ignored to run node against the fetched payload. There is no pinning, no integrity check, and the fetched code is attacker-controlled and mutable. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` and grants remote code execution on Windows installers, with deliberate stealth wrapping to hide the child process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
